wellknown.name: BlockRun
wellknown.description: AI routing & payment layer. Access 91 LLMs and third-party data & runtime services via x402 micropayments on Base. No API keys required.
wellknown.instructions:
BlockRun is an AI routing and payment layer. Every paid resource below is billed per request in USDC via x402 — no API keys, no accounts, no subscriptions.

## No wallet? Start free
9 open-weight chat models are free and require no wallet, no key and no signup. POST /api/v1/chat/completions with one of the free model ids and no payment header. Use this path first when a language model is all you need.

## Getting able to pay
1. A wallet is auto-created on first use by the MCP server and by every SDK. The private key stays on the caller's machine and signs x402 headers locally; it is never sent to BlockRun.
2. To fund with a card, POST /api/v1/onramp/token with {"address":"0x..."}. It is free and settles nothing — the x402 signature proves you control the wallet, so the address must match the signer — and it returns a one-time Coinbase Onramp link.
3. Or send USDC directly to that address on Base or Solana.

## Paying for a request
Call the endpoint with no payment header, read the requirements off the 402, sign, and retry with X-PAYMENT. Prices in this document are indicative: read the 402 for the amount that will actually be charged, and GET /api/v1/models for live per-token pricing rather than trusting a cached figure.

## What you pay for
You pay for the upstream round trip. If a call fails on OUR side — the provider is down, times out, or returns a JSON-RPC -32603 — it does not settle, so a retry is free. If the upstream rejects what you sent (unknown method, invalid params, a reverted call), it does settle: we made the call on your behalf. Requests we can reject LOCALLY, before contacting anyone, are always free. Check the balance before an expensive call (video generation is the priciest category), but do not avoid retrying a call that failed on our side.

## Further reading
https://blockrun.ai/skill.md — install and wallet setup, as an agent skill.
https://blockrun.ai/agent.md — HTTP reference for calling the API directly.
https://blockrun.ai/llms.txt — full catalog: every endpoint with its current price.
